scope: read-only caption and CBR source audit; no source evaluation, manuscript, external or synced files modified

caption.reason: All 13 existing query-free caption evaluations score only 500 object-type units; association is unscored and ROH denominator is zero. Captions have no support-judgment fields. The stored object-claim error cannot supply the required two-type EOH average or ROH FAR.
caption.summary_target_coverage_field_bug: tasks_t1_t3_t4.json/t3 uses target_coverage but raw caption records use target_covered; the correct existing coverage values are in 13models_4tasks_metrics.json and current appendix. No cache field changed.
caption.joint_caption_distinction: t4 caption_hallu_neg is generated text conditioned on the explicit referring query, assessed on negative queries; it is not query-free captioning and cannot replace the caption task.
caption.prospective_re_evaluation_note: Scoring the unchanged captions against association, attribute and relation annotation units would be a new derived evaluation, rather than aggregation of existing outcomes; no such re-evaluation performed here.

contract.eligibility: valid positive predicted region with IoU against annotated ground truth >= 0.5
contract.reuse: IoU of negative predicted region against original positive prediction >= 0.8
contract.denominator: original fixed n_c for each model shared across all four types; negative refusals remain included
contract.EOH: arithmetic mean of object and co_occurrence CBR
contract.ROH: arithmetic mean of attribute and relation CBR
contract.family_aggregation: equal arithmetic model weight from full-precision sources; never pooling numerators by n_c
